item.title: Authentication Logs
item.description: Trustgrid records information for authentication attempts into the control plane. This information can be used to troubleshoot authentication issues or monitor for suspicious activity. Authentication logs are available by navigating to Operations > Authentication Logs. Authentication Logs Viewing authentication logs requires audits::read:user permissions. Successful logins from external identity providers are logged, but failed attempts are not. Check your IDP’s documentation for information on how to view those. The following information is shown for each entry:

item.title: Configuration Changes
item.description: Trustgrid records information about changes users make to all configuration. This can be helpful when troubleshooting recent changes. Configuration changes for the entire organization are available by navigating to Operations > Changes. Configuration changes table showing recent changes across the organization Viewing configuration changes requires audits::read:config permissions. The following information is shown for each change: Field Name Description Date When the change was made IP The IP address from which the change originated Event The type of change (delete/create/change/action).

item.title: Organization Node Audits
item.description: Node audits provide records when services on a node are invoked, or when upgrades are applied. This page shows node audits from all nodes in an organization. Node audits for the entire organization are available by navigating to Operations > Node Audits. To view audits for a specific node, navigate to that node and select Audits under the History section. See Node Audits for more information. Viewing node audits requires audits::read:node permissions.
